common_intent_requirements.text: 把一颗小球放在倾斜木板的高处
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 把一颗小球放在倾斜木板的高处
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: One hand places a single small ball at the high end and holds it completely still against the board.
The fingers open and the hand moves away without adding a push.

common_intent_requirements.text: 让它自己沿着木板滚下来
common_intent_requirements.normal_source_quote: 让它自己沿着木板滚下来
common_intent_requirements.h3_refined_evidence: The ball begins moving down the slope on its own and rolls along the wooden surface toward the low end.

physics_checks.criterion: 没有后续推动时，小球沿斜面向低处运动，接触过程连续。
physics_checks.observable_evidence: 板的高低方向可辨，小球释放后经过中段并到达低端。
fail_examples: 释放后小球无外力持续逆坡向上运动
球穿过木板或跳过中间路径
木板自行抬起把球运到低处
not_required: 允许少量滑动，不要求严格无滑动滚动
不测滚动加速度、摩擦系数或最终速度

evaluation_boundary: Assess only supplied requirements. Professional additions are not hidden requirements for ordinary input.
